defs.def: the group of people who have gathered to watch or listen to sth (a play, concert, sb speaking, etc.) （戏剧、音乐会或演讲等的）观众，听众

ex.s: Keep your audience in mind.
ex.t: 自行车租赁与导览游

ex.s: Even the most engaged and committed audience will eventually get bored.
ex.t: 骑行是最经济、最可持续、最有趣的探索这座城市的方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas or to take a role in explaining new concepts and policies to others.
ex.t: 请听众贡献想法，或让他们承担向他人解释新概念和新政策的角色。

ex.s: Get the audience involved.
ex.t: 让观众参与进来。

ex.s: Additionally, it could serve a larger audience such as a hospital, restaurant or school.
ex.t: 此外，它也可以服务更大的群体，比如医院、餐厅或学校。

ex.s: The 4-Week Learning Sprint is open to anyone, with the target audience aged between 20 and 28.
ex.t: 四周学习冲刺面向所有人开放，目标受众年龄在20至28岁之间。

ex.s: Every weekend this is “Wales” premier comedy club where having a great time is the order for both audiences and comedy stars alike.
ex.t: 每个周末这里都是"威尔士"顶级喜剧俱乐部，观众和喜剧明星都能在这里度过美好时光。

ex.s: He ignores the audience.
ex.t: 他无视观众。

ex.s: Talk directly to your audience, be yourself and make a connection.
ex.t: 直接对你的听众说话，做真实的自己，并建立联系。

ex.s: It seemed to go on forever!” So surprise your audience.
ex.t: 让你的演讲总是比预期的稍微短一点。

ex.s: The objective of most speeches is to benefit the audience.
ex.t: 通过关注听众来消除对公开演讲的恐惧。

ex.s: Keep their audience in mind.
ex.t: 心中有观众。

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 然而，尽管有各种庆祝活动，在美国，爵士乐听众仍在萎缩并老龄化，这种音乐也未能与年轻一代产生共鸣。

ex.s: As the Kennedy Center’s artistic adviser for jazz, Moran hopes to widen the audience for jazz, make the music more accessible, and preserve its history and culture.
ex.t: 作为肯尼迪中心的爵士乐艺术顾问，莫兰希望扩大爵士乐的听众群，让这种音乐更容易被人接受，并保护其历史和文化。

ex.s: By translating the rich and humourous text of Love’s Labour’s Lost into the physical language of BSL, Deafinitely Theatre creates a new interpretation of Shakespeare’s comedy and aims to build a bridge between deaf and hearing worlds by performing to both groups as one audience.
ex.t: 通过将《爱的徒劳》丰富幽默的文本翻译成英式手语这种肢体语言，Deafinitely剧院为莎士比亚的喜剧创造了一种新的诠释，并旨在通过为聋人和听力正常的人共同演出，在两者之间架起一座桥梁。

ex.s: Though the movie is 30 years old, most of the 250 seats were filled with teary-eyed audience wanting to say good-bye to the old building.
ex.t: 尽管这部电影已有30年历史，但250个座位几乎坐满了眼含泪水的观众，他们想向这座老建筑告别。

ex.s: The theater audience said good-bye as Bradford locked the doors for the last time.
ex.t: 当布拉德福德最后一次锁门时，剧院观众告别了。

ex.s: It was done with the help of the audience.
ex.t: 它是在观众的帮助下完成的。

ex.s: The audience requested it.
ex.t: 观众要求的。

ex.s: What can we infer about the audience?
ex.t: 关于观众我们可以推断出什么？

ex.s: By translating the rich and humourous text of Love’s Labour’s Lost into the physical language of BSL,Deafinitely Theatre creates a new interpretation of Shakespeare’s comedy and aims to build a bridge between deaf and hearing worlds by performing to both groups as one audience.
ex.t: 通过将《爱的徒劳》丰富幽默的文本翻译成英式手语这种肢体语言，Deafinitely剧院为莎士比亚的喜剧创造了一种新的诠释，并旨在通过为聋人和听力正常的人共同演出，在两者之间架起一座桥梁。

ex.s: Tickets for the 2017 Grand Chinese New Year Concert in St Petersburg sold out, with 90% of the audience local Russians.
ex.t: 2017年圣彼得堡中国新年音乐会的门票售罄， 90%的观众是俄罗斯当地人。

ex.s: People are also discovering the fun of interacting with the celebrations, rather than simply watching as part of an audience.
ex.t: 人们也在发现参与庆典互动的乐趣，而不仅仅是作为观众观看。

ex.s: The performers of course sang in Chinese, but the music, exaggerated movements and mime helped get the meanings across to the audience.
ex.t: 表演者当然用中文唱，但音乐、夸张的动作和哑剧帮助把意思传达给观众。

ex.s: Interestingly,audiences have in recent years turned to television series such as Sherlock or Mad Men, which can have many characters and gradual plot development.
ex.t: 有趣的是，近年来观众转向了像《神探夏洛克》或《广告狂人》这样的电视剧集，这些剧集可以有众多角色和渐进的剧情发展。

defs.def: a number of people or a particular group of people who watch, read or listen to the same thing （同一事物的）观众，读者，听众

ex.s: The very best communicators are those who know how to adjust their language to match their audience.
ex.t: 最好的沟通者是那些知道如何根据读者调整语言的人。

ex.s: To get the most out of reading these plays, try to picture the play on stage, with you, the reader, in the audience.
ex.t: 要充分阅读这些剧本，试着想象舞台上的演出场景，你——读者——坐在观众席上。

ex.s: It’s partly true that Dickens’ style of writing attracted audiences
ex.t: 狄更斯的写作风格吸引了来自社会各阶层的读者，这部分是正确的。

ex.s: Take, for example,the epic movie Tory, which is in part based on Homer’s The Iliad and was met with mixed reviews from the audience.
ex.t: 在前往行星的旅程中，它可能会受到陨石的严重损坏。

defs.def: a formal meeting with an important person （与要人的）会见；觐见；进见
